content.title: Duke basketball vs TCU score, highlights: Cameron Boozer, Blue Devils advance to Sweet 16
content.text: Updated March 21, 2026, 7:48 p.m. ETGREENVILLE, S.C. — Duke basketball earned a 81-58 win against TCU in March Madness to secure a spot in the Sweet 16 of the men’s NCAA Tournament. The top-seeded Blue Devils (34-2) took down the ninth-seeded Horned Frogs (23-12) with a second-half surge at Bon Secours Wellnes Arena to earn their 31st Sweet 16 berth in program history. Duke outscored TCU 43-24 in the second half.Cameron Boozer scored 17 of his 19 points in the second half and grabbed 11 rebounds in a double-double performance. Duke used a 30-10 extended run to turn away any chance of an upset for TCU. Isaiah Evans (17 points), Dame Sarr (14 points) and Maliq Brown (12 points) joined Boozer as double-figure scorers. Fourth-year coach Jon Scheyer has now led Duke to at least the Sweet 16 in three straight seasons. The Blue Devils will face No. 4 seed Kansas (24-10) or No. 5 seed St. John’s (29-6) at the East Regional at Capital One Arena in Washington, D.C., on Friday, March 27. A tipoff time will be announced when that information becomes available.
